load_lvis_dataset: load LVIS v1 dataset from JSON file and return dataset records with annotations and image metadata
register_lvis_instances: register LVIS instances in Detectron2 DatasetCatalog with custom metadata and image root
register_lvis_zeroshot: register all LVIS zero-shot dataset splits including train+coco, minival, and rare category splits
load_lvis_random_images: load LVIS dataset with images shuffled randomly for training data augmentation
load_lvis_negative_categories: load LVIS dataset with negative and positive category IDs converted to 0-based indexing
